items.name: foundation
items.title: Skrewww Foundation
items.description: Universal Primitive/Semantic/Brand tokens, component-tier defaults required by distributed components, Shape/Surface mode overrides, and the shared .sr-only accessibility utility. Installed once; every other @skrewww/* component depends on it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button is a primary interactive trigger for user actions — submit, confirm, navigate, or initiate a process.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card is a general-purpose content container grouping related information with a clear visual boundary.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Text Input is a single-line text entry for short, free-form data such as names, emails, or search terms.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: Form Field is a shared field wrapper for label, description, required indicator, and validation placement — not a visual input.

items.name: validation-message
items.title: Validation Message
items.description: Validation Message is inline typed feedback paired with a field — error, warning, success, or info — with icon and text.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinner is an indeterminate loading indicator for operations without a meaningful completion percentage.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Divider is a thin separator line between content sections — horizontal or vertical, semantic or decorative.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Link is semantic navigational text styled as inline or standalone links — not for primary actions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox is a native checkbox for independent or multi-select choices, including indeterminate group states.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: React progress bar for uploads and background tasks, with measured value/max progress, an indeterminate mode, a visible label, and optional percentage text.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton is temporary placeholder shapes that preserve layout while known content is loading.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio is a native radio button for a single option inside a mutually exclusive group.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch is a boolean settings control for immediate on/off changes — not a substitute for Checkbox in forms.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea is a multi-line native textarea for longer free-text content, composed with FormField for label and validation.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination is a paged navigation control with Previous/Next boundaries, numbered pages, and optional ellipsis.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar is a circular visual identity for a user or entity with image, initials, or icon fallback.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb is an ordered hierarchical trail showing location with navigable ancestors and a current-page indicator.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio Group is an accessible grouping layer for mutually exclusive radio options with legend, helper text, and errors.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider is a single-value control for selecting a number within min/max by dragging or keyboard-adjusting a thumb along a track.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Stepper shows progress through a fixed, known-length, ordered sequence of named steps — a compound Stepper + Step API built against the verified live Navigation/Step Item component set.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table is a native HTML table foundation with captions, headers, body rows, footers, cell alignment, responsive overflow, RTL support, print-friendly scrolling, and composition patterns for empty/loading/error — not the interactive Data Table pattern (no sorting, selection, or pagination).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge is a compact non-interactive label for status, classification, or numeric counts at a glance.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Tag is a compact classification label for categories, filters, or user-applied values — distinct from read-only Badge status metadata.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: List Item is a single row inside a collection — avatar, title, description, metadata, and optional trailing content.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Timeline is a vertical, chronological event list built on Content/Timeline Item rows — Default outlined-ring or Highlighted solid-dot markers, connector suppression purely positional.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty State is a zero-content placeholder with title, description, and optional recovery actions for collections, search, or first-use flows.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert is a persistent inline feedback block for contextual status tied to page content — not auto-dismissing.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast is a transient floating notification for confirming actions or reporting short-lived events.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Button Group joins related independent Buttons with shared outer chrome and a 2px divider gap — layout only; each Button keeps its own behavior.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle Group is exclusive segmented selection (radiogroup) with joined chrome — Segmented Control is this presentation, not a separate component.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion is a set of stacked collapsible sections for progressive disclosure, built from Accordion Item building blocks.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs is a navigation pattern that switches between related in-context views using tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics and roving focus.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: Search Field is a search-specific text field with leading magnifying-glass icon and optional clear action — built on shared text-input control behavior.

items.name: credit-card-field
items.title: Credit Card Field
items.description: Credit Card Field is a compound UI control for card number, expiry, and CVC in one shell — visual pattern only, not a payment processor or PCI vault.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Number Input is direct numeric entry with optional steppers and min/max/step — not currency, quantity business logic, or a Slider.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: File Upload is a native file input with drag-and-drop dropzone, advisory validation, selected-file list, and multipart form submission — selection only, not network upload.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover is a non-modal floating panel for supplementary or lightly interactive content anchored to a trigger.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip is a brief supplementary label for a trigger, shown on keyboard focus or pointer hover.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog is a modal overlay that interrupts workflow for focused attention, information, or a decision.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Drawer is an edge-anchored modal panel for supplementary settings, filters, or secondary forms.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Menu is a compact command surface for contextual actions — distinct from Select (form values) and Popover (supplementary content).

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Split Button joins one primary Button action with a related Menu trigger using shared outer chrome — composition only; Button and Menu keep their own APIs.

items.name: calendar-day
items.title: Calendar Day
items.description: Calendar Day is a single selectable day cell inside a month calendar grid.

items.name: calendar-grid
items.title: Calendar Grid
items.description: Calendar Grid is a composed month-view calendar with single-date or range selection and grid keyboard navigation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select is a combobox-style single-select with a Popover listbox trigger and hidden native select for form submission.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Combobox is an editable searchable single-select with a filterable listbox — distinct from non-searchable Select and query-only Search Field.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date Picker is a date-only field with editable D MMM YYYY text entry (en-GB) and calendar popover for single-date selection.

items.name: phone-number-field
items.title: Phone Number Field
items.description: Phone Number Field pairs a country/dial-code selector with a phone number input — UI pattern only, not SMS verification or carrier lookup.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: Tree View is a hierarchical, keyboard-navigable tree — file explorers, nested category browsers, org charts. Composes Content/Tree Item rows with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation and depth-based indentation.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Data Table is an interactive data-table pattern composing Table with header sorting and external Pagination — no columns-config prop; the consumer writes their own Table/TableHead/TableBody markup and drops in DataTableSortHeader for sortable columns.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Bar Chart compares categories with vertical or horizontal bars — a single series by default, or several series grouped, stacked, or stacked to 100%. Static and non-tabbable, with the data also exposed as a hidden table.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: Line Chart shows a trend across ordered categories — a single series by default, or several series as separate lines. Static and non-tabbable, with an optional sparkline mode and the data also exposed as a hidden table.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Area Chart shows magnitude over ordered categories with a filled area under each line — a single series by default, or several series overlapped, stacked, or stacked to 100%. Static and non-tabbable, with the data also exposed as a hidden table.

items.name: chart-card
items.title: Chart Card
items.description: Chart Card is a Card composed for a chart: an optional title/description/actions header, and a body that owns loading/empty/error presentation around a chart the consumer supplies as children.

items.name: chart-metric
items.title: Chart Metric
items.description: Chart Metric is a labeled value with an optional directional delta, for use above a chart or standalone — the delta's direction drives only its icon, never a color.
